note: Allen County KY has zoning: Scottsville code 153.026 names the official 'Zoning Map - Scottsville-Allen County', kept at the Scottsville-Allen County Planning Commission office; the commission's website has only a Google Maps view and a text zoning ordinance PDF. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online (including the Scottsville city org transit_scottsvillegis, BRADD portal, KyGovMaps, KYGeoNet) found no zoning district service. Only commercial parcel data with zoning fields (paid) was found. No public queryable zoning layer exists.
